title: 光片顯微鏡
summary: 從照明與偵測互相垂直的光路出發，理解光片顯微鏡為何能以極低光劑量做活體與透明化組織的 3D 成像，再把光束腰與瑞利長度、掃描光片與滾動快門同步、偵測取樣、光片共面校正、散射與折射率失配預算、多視角融合與資料管線整合成可交接的光片系統工程。
summaryEn: Start from mutually perpendicular illumination and detection paths to see why light-sheet microscopes image live and cleared samples in 3D at very low light dose, then integrate beam waist and Rayleigh range, scanned sheets synchronized to rolling shutters, detection sampling, sheet coplanarity calibration, scattering and index-mismatch budgets, multiview fusion and data pipelines into a transferable light-sheet system record.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 光片設計練習：以 40×/0.8 水浸偵測物鏡為斑馬魚胚胎成像，視野 333 µm、λ = 488 nm。靜態高斯光片要涵蓋全視野需 z_R = 166 µm，w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm，光片 FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm，等效軸向 FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm，光片厚度約為 1.08 µm 景深的 4.8 倍，焦外背景高。改用 w0 = 2 µm 的軸向掃描光片：快門狹縫 211 列，最大光片 FWHM 2.63 µm，等效軸向 ≤ 1.67 µm，厚度／景深比降到 2.4。每幀 50 ms、2 µm 步距取 200 層，每疊 10 s，可容納 30 s 間隔；每疊資料 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB，24 小時 2880 疊約 4.8 TB。若 24 小時後要保留一半訊號，每疊漂白須 ≤ 0.024%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Light-sheet design exercise: imaging a zebrafish embryo with a 40×/0.8 water-immersion detection objective over a 333 µm field at λ = 488 nm. A static Gaussian sheet covering the field needs z_R = 166 µm, w0 = √(166×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.4 µm and a sheet FWHM ≈ 5.2 µm, giving an effective axial FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/5.2²) ≈ 2.0 µm with a sheet 4.8 times the 1.08 µm depth of field and heavy out-of-focus background. An axially swept sheet with w0 = 2 µm uses a 211-row shutter slit, a maximum sheet FWHM of 2.63 µm and an effective axial FWHM ≤ 1.67 µm, cutting the thickness-to-depth-of-field ratio to 2.4. At 50 ms per frame and a 2 µm step, 200 planes take 10 s per stack, fitting a 30 s interval; each stack holds 200×8.39 MB ≈ 1.68 GB and 2880 stacks in 24 hours about 4.8 TB. Keeping half the signal after 24 hours requires bleaching ≤ 0.024% per stack. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「正交照明、光學切片與光劑量」與「光片厚度與視野的取捨」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose" and "Sheet thickness versus field of view": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 正交照明、光學切片與光劑量：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「正交照明與偵測物鏡」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orthogonal illumination and detection” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光片顯微鏡把照明與偵測拆成兩條互相垂直的光路：照明物鏡從側面送入一片薄光，只激發偵測物鏡焦平面附近的螢光，偵測物鏡則以寬場方式一次拍下整個平面。和寬場或共軛焦顯微鏡不同，拍這一層時焦平面外的分子根本沒有被照到，所以光學切片來自照明而不是針孔，整個體積的光劑量與光漂白大幅降低。代價是樣品必須能從側面進光，並放在充滿浸潤液的樣品槽中，與兩支物鏡的工作距離和幾何互相牽制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「正交照明與偵測物鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A light-sheet microscope splits illumination and detection into two perpendicular paths: an illumination objective sends a thin sheet of light in from the side, exciting fluorescence only near the focal plane of the detection objective, which records the whole plane at once in widefield fashion. Unlike widefield or confocal microscopes, molecules outside the focal plane are simply not illuminated while that plane is recorded, so optical sectioning comes from the illumination rather than a pinhole and the light dose and photobleaching of the whole volume fall sharply. The price is that the sample must admit light from the side and sit in a chamber filled with immersion medium, its geometry constrained by the working distances of two objectives. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Orthogonal illumination and detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 400 µm thick sample at a 2 µm step needs 200 planes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片顯微鏡溫和只是因為用了較弱的雷射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Light-sheet microscopy is gentle only because it uses a weaker laser." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「正交照明與偵測物鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Orthogonal illumination and detection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 正交照明、光學切片與光劑量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「正交照明與偵測物鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orthogonal illumination and detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。寬場每拍一層整個樣品都被照到，每個分子一疊被照 200 次；光片 1/e² 全厚 4 µm 時每個分子只被約 2 層照到。若每次曝光漂白 0.1%（教學假設），寬場一疊後已漂白 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18%，光片僅約 0.2%；做 100 個時間點，光片累計約 18%，寬場則幾乎完全漂白。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 400 µm thick sample at a 2 µm step needs 200 planes. In widefield the whole sample is lit for every plane, so each molecule is exposed 200 times per stack; with a light sheet of 4 µm 1/e² full thickness each molecule is lit by only about 2 planes. If each exposure bleaches 0.1% (teaching assumption), one widefield stack bleaches 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18% while the light sheet bleaches about 0.2%; after 100 time points the light sheet has accumulated about 18% and widefield has bleached almost completely. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比；活體樣品則同時記錄細胞分裂速率等生理指標作為光毒性的旁證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio; for live samples also log physiological indicators such as cell-division rate as collateral evidence of phototoxicity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。寬場每拍一層整個樣品都被照到，每個分子一疊被照 200 次；光片 1/e² 全厚 4 µm 時每個分子只被約 2 層照到。若每次曝光漂白 0.1%（教學假設），寬場一疊後已漂白 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18%，光片僅約 0.2%；做 100 個時間點，光片累計約 18%，寬場則幾乎完全漂白。
knowledge.textEn: A 400 µm thick sample at a 2 µm step needs 200 planes. In widefield the whole sample is lit for every plane, so each molecule is exposed 200 times per stack; with a light sheet of 4 µm 1/e² full thickness each molecule is lit by only about 2 planes. If each exposure bleaches 0.1% (teaching assumption), one widefield stack bleaches 1 − 0.999²⁰⁰ ≈ 18% while the light sheet bleaches about 0.2%; after 100 time points the light sheet has accumulated about 18% and widefield has bleached almost completely.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「正交照明、光學切片與光劑量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose", which statement holds?
options: 光片的厚度就是系統的軸向解析度。
樣品透明之後，深處影像就和表面一樣清楚。
400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。
optionsEn: The sheet thickness is the system's axial resolution.
Once a sample is cleared, deep images are as sharp as the surface.
A 400 µm thick sample at a 2 µm step needs 200 planes.
quiz.explanation: 400 µm 厚樣品以 2 µm 步距取 200 層。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 正交照明、光學切片與光劑量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「正交照明與偵測物鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Orthogonal illumination and detection” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比；活體樣品則同時記錄細胞分裂速率等生理指標作為光毒性的旁證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio; for live samples also log physiological indicators such as cell-division rate as collateral evidence of phototoxicity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了提高訊號把照明功率調高 10 倍並加長曝光，影像更乾淨，但胚胎數小時後發育明顯變慢、細胞分裂停滯；團隊只看影像品質沒有監測生理指標，把光毒性造成的異常當成生物學發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: To raise signal the illumination power is increased tenfold with longer exposures, the images look cleaner, but after a few hours embryo development slows markedly and cell division stalls; the team watched only image quality, not physiology, and reported a phototoxic artefact as a biological finding.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比；活體樣品則同時記錄細胞分裂速率等生理指標作為光毒性的旁證。
knowledge.textEn: Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio; for live samples also log physiological indicators such as cell-division rate as collateral evidence of phototoxicity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「正交照明、光學切片與光劑量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose"?
options: 以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
光片實驗的限制主要在光學，資料處理只是後續小事。
optionsEn: Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Optics is the main limit; data handling is a minor afterthought.
quiz.explanation: 以均勻螢光的凝膠或固定樣品，在相同總照明能量下分別以寬場與光片模式重複取 100 疊，量每疊平均強度對次數的衰減並擬合每次曝光的漂白率，比較兩者比值是否接近層數與光片厚度／步距之比；活體樣品則同時記錄細胞分裂速率等生理指標作為光毒性的旁證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a uniformly fluorescent gel or fixed sample at equal total illumination energy, acquire 100 stacks each in widefield and light-sheet mode, measure mean intensity decay versus stack number and fit the bleach rate per exposure, checking that the ratio approaches plane count divided by sheet-thickness-to-step ratio; for live samples also log physiological indicators such as cell-division rate as collateral evidence of phototoxicity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 正交照明、光學切片與光劑量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 光片厚度與視野的取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sheet thickness versus field of view: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高斯光束腰與瑞利長度」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以高斯光束形成的光片最薄處是光束腰 w0，離開腰後依 w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²) 變厚，瑞利長度 z_R = πn·w0²/λ。習慣上把可用視野定為 2z_R，此時邊緣厚度是中心的 √2 倍；由於 z_R 與 w0² 成正比，光片薄一半，可用視野就縮成四分之一。貝索光束與晶格光片以錐狀角譜延長無繞射長度，但貝索光束的旁瓣攜帶大量能量，在焦平面外造成背景與漂白；晶格光片以干涉圖樣壓抑旁瓣，在厚度、視野與旁瓣之間取得不同平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯光束腰與瑞利長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet formed by a Gaussian beam is thinnest at the waist w0 and thickens away from it as w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²), with Rayleigh range z_R = πn·w0²/λ. The usable field is conventionally taken as 2z_R, where the edge thickness is √2 times the centre; because z_R scales with w0², halving the sheet thickness quarters the usable field. Bessel beams and lattice sheets extend the non-diffracting length with a conical angular spectrum, but Bessel side lobes carry much of the energy and cause out-of-focus background and bleaching, while lattice sheets suppress side lobes through interference, striking a different balance among thickness, field and side lobes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ = 488 nm、水中 n = 1.33：w0 = 2 µm 時 z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm，視野約 68 µm，中心 FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm；w0 = 5 µm 時 z_R ≈ 214 µm，視野約 428 µm，但 FWHM 增為 5.9 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With λ = 488 nm in water (n = 1.33): w0 = 2 µm gives z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm, a field of about 68 µm and a centre FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm; w0 = 5 µm gives z_R ≈ 214 µm and a field of about 428 µm, but the FWHM grows to 5.9 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片越薄越好，做薄不需要付出代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thinner sheet is always better and costs nothing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 光片厚度與視野的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sheet thickness versus field of view: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高斯光束腰與瑞利長度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = 488 nm、水中 n = 1.33：w0 = 2 µm 時 z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm，視野約 68 µm，中心 FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm；w0 = 5 µm 時 z_R ≈ 214 µm，視野約 428 µm，但 FWHM 增為 5.9 µm。若要求 400 µm 視野，w0 = √(z_R·λ/(πn)) = √(200×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.8 µm，1/e² 全厚約 9.7 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With λ = 488 nm in water (n = 1.33): w0 = 2 µm gives z_R = π×1.33×2²/0.488 ≈ 34 µm, a field of about 68 µm and a centre FWHM = 1.18w0 ≈ 2.4 µm; w0 = 5 µm gives z_R ≈ 214 µm and a field of about 428 µm, but the FWHM grows to 5.9 µm. Requiring a 400 µm field means w0 = √(z_R·λ/(πn)) = √(200×0.488/(π×1.33)) ≈ 4.8 µm, a 1/e² full thickness of about 9.7 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在螢光素溶液中把光片轉 90° 以偵測相機直接拍光片側影，或在凝膠中取 100 nm 螢光珠的軸向 PSF，於視野多個位置量厚度，擬合 w(z) 求 w0 與 z_R 並與照明 NA 設計值比較；同時確認光束腰的實際位置是否位於視野中央。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In fluorescein solution rotate the sheet by 90° and photograph its profile directly with the detection camera, or take axial PSFs of 100 nm beads in gel, measure thickness at several field positions, fit w(z) to obtain w0 and z_R and compare with the design illumination NA; also confirm that the actual waist lies at the centre of the field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 在螢光素溶液中把光片轉 90° 以偵測相機直接拍光片側影，或在凝膠中取 100 nm 螢光珠的軸向 PSF，於視野多個位置量厚度，擬合 w(z) 求 w0 與 z_R 並與照明 NA 設計值比較；同時確認光束腰的實際位置是否位於視野中央。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 注意干擾：照明側擴束器被換成較小倍率，照明 NA 降低，w0 由 2 µm 變成 3 µm，視野雖變大，但焦外背景增加使細胞核邊界模糊；因為沒有光片厚度的驗收紀錄，研究者以為是樣品準備問題，重做了數週的樣品。

steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 掃描光片、軸向掃描與相機同步：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scanned sheets, axial sweeping and camera synchronization: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光片可以用柱狀透鏡一次形成靜態平面，也可以用振鏡把細光束在焦平面內快速掃過（數位掃描光片），後者強度均勻、可逐行調變，還能做擺動掃描改變入射角，把吸收物造成的條紋陰影平均掉。要突破厚度與視野的取捨，可用電調焦透鏡沿傳播方向移動光束腰，並與 sCMOS 相機的滾動快門同步，讓每一列像素只在光束腰經過時曝光，整個視野都用最薄的那段光片成像。代價是同步時序變成關鍵規格，振鏡、透鏡與相機的觸發抖動直接變成厚度誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet can be formed statically by a cylindrical lens or by a galvanometer sweeping a thin beam rapidly across the focal plane (a digitally scanned light sheet); the latter is uniform, modulable line by line and can pivot to change the incidence angle, averaging away stripe shadows behind absorbers. To break the thickness-versus-field trade-off, an electrically tunable lens moves the waist along the propagation direction in sync with an sCMOS rolling shutter so each pixel row is exposed only while the waist passes, imaging the whole field with the thinnest part of the sheet. The price is that synchronization timing becomes a key specification, and trigger jitter among galvo, lens and camera turns directly into thickness error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：40×、6.5 µm 像素，樣品端 0.1625 µm/列，2048 列視野 333 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 40× and 6.5 µm pixels the sample-side row pitch is 0.1625 µm and 2048 rows span 333 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片顯微鏡的視野只由偵測物鏡與相機決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The light-sheet field is set only by the detection objective and camera." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 掃描光片、軸向掃描與相機同步：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scanned sheets, axial sweeping and camera synchronization: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：40×、6.5 µm 像素，樣品端 0.1625 µm/列，2048 列視野 333 µm。w0 = 2 µm（照明 NA ≈ λ/(πw0) ≈ 0.078）的光束腰掃過整個視野，只讓寬 z_R ≈ 34 µm（約 211 列）的快門狹縫曝光，狹縫內最大寬度 √1.25·w0 ≈ 1.12w0；同樣 w0 的靜態光片只涵蓋 68 µm。每幀 100 ms 時光束腰移動 3.33 mm/s，每列 48.8 µs，觸發抖動須遠小於此值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 40× and 6.5 µm pixels the sample-side row pitch is 0.1625 µm and 2048 rows span 333 µm. A waist of w0 = 2 µm (illumination NA ≈ λ/(πw0) ≈ 0.078) swept across the field with a shutter slit only z_R ≈ 34 µm wide (about 211 rows) keeps the maximum width within √1.25·w0 ≈ 1.12w0, whereas a static sheet of the same w0 covers only 68 µm. At 100 ms per frame the waist moves at 3.33 mm/s, 48.8 µs per row, so trigger jitter must be far smaller. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在均勻螢光樣品中改變滾動快門與電調透鏡之間的延遲，量影像亮度與軸向 PSF 對延遲的曲線，找出最佳相位與容許範圍；以示波器同時記錄相機列觸發、電調透鏡驅動與振鏡位置訊號，確認抖動小於數微秒；最後在螢光珠凝膠中檢查全視野軸向 PSF 的一致性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a uniformly fluorescent sample vary the delay between rolling shutter and tunable lens and plot image brightness and axial PSF against delay to find the optimum phase and its tolerance; record camera row trigger, tunable-lens drive and galvo position together on an oscilloscope to confirm jitter of a few microseconds or less; finally check axial-PSF uniformity across the field in a bead gel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 掃描光片、軸向掃描與相機同步：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scanned sheets, axial sweeping and camera synchronization: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在均勻螢光樣品中改變滾動快門與電調透鏡之間的延遲，量影像亮度與軸向 PSF 對延遲的曲線，找出最佳相位與容許範圍；以示波器同時記錄相機列觸發、電調透鏡驅動與振鏡位置訊號，確認抖動小於數微秒；最後在螢光珠凝膠中檢查全視野軸向 PSF 的一致性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In a uniformly fluorescent sample vary the delay between rolling shutter and tunable lens and plot image brightness and axial PSF against delay to find the optimum phase and its tolerance; record camera row trigger, tunable-lens drive and galvo position together on an oscilloscope to confirm jitter of a few microseconds or less; finally check axial-PSF uniformity across the field in a bead gel. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：電調焦透鏡長時間運轉後升溫、焦距漂移，光束腰與快門狹縫逐漸錯開，影像一側變暗、軸向解析度在視野一端劣化 40%；因為漂移緩慢，只在下午的實驗出現，被誤認為樣品褪色。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After hours of operation the tunable lens warms and its focal power drifts, the waist gradually slips out of step with the shutter slit, one side of the image darkens and axial resolution degrades by 40% at one end of the field; because the drift is slow it appears only in afternoon experiments and is mistaken for sample fading.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在均勻螢光樣品中改變滾動快門與電調透鏡之間的延遲，量影像亮度與軸向 PSF 對延遲的曲線，找出最佳相位與容許範圍；以示波器同時記錄相機列觸發、電調透鏡驅動與振鏡位置訊號，確認抖動小於數微秒；最後在螢光珠凝膠中檢查全視野軸向 PSF 的一致性。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掃描光片、軸向掃描與相機同步」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 偵測光路、取樣與等效軸向解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Detection path, sampling and effective axial resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偵測端本身是一台寬場顯微鏡：物鏡 NA 決定橫向解析度與景深，相機像素換算到樣品端的大小決定是否滿足奈奎斯特取樣。光片系統的軸向點擴散函數是照明光片剖面與偵測軸向 PSF 的乘積，兩者都影響軸向解析度：低 NA 偵測的大視野系統由光片厚度主導，高 NA 偵測時由偵測景深主導，光片則負責壓抑焦外背景。偵測物鏡必須浸在樣品槽介質中，工作距離、物鏡外殼角度與照明物鏡的幾何干涉限制了可用的 NA 組合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The detection side is itself a widefield microscope: objective NA sets lateral resolution and depth of field, and camera pixel size referred to the sample decides whether Nyquist sampling is met. The axial point-spread function of a light-sheet system is the product of the sheet profile and the detection axial PSF, so both affect axial resolution: large-field systems with low-NA detection are dominated by sheet thickness, while high-NA detection is dominated by detection depth of field and the sheet mainly suppresses out-of-focus background. The detection objective must dip into the chamber medium, and working distance, nosepiece angle and geometric interference with the illumination objective limit the usable NA combinations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偵測 NA 0.8 水浸、發射 520 nm：橫向解析度 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm，奈奎斯特像素須 ≤ 0.20 µm，40× 搭配 6.5 µm 像素為 0.1625 µm，合格。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With NA 0.8 water-immersion detection at 520 nm emission, lateral resolution is 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm and Nyquist needs pixels ≤ 0.20 µm; 40× with 6.5 µm pixels gives 0.1625 µm, which passes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片的厚度就是系統的軸向解析度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sheet thickness is the system's axial resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 偵測光路、取樣與等效軸向解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detection path, sampling and effective axial resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偵測 NA 0.8 水浸、發射 520 nm：橫向解析度 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm，奈奎斯特像素須 ≤ 0.20 µm，40× 搭配 6.5 µm 像素為 0.1625 µm，合格。偵測軸向 FWHM ≈ 2nλ/NA² = 2×1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 2.16 µm，光片 FWHM 2.35 µm；兩個高斯相乘時 1/FWHM² 相加，等效軸向 FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/2.35²) ≈ 1.59 µm，比任一單獨值都小。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With NA 0.8 water-immersion detection at 520 nm emission, lateral resolution is 0.61λ/NA ≈ 0.40 µm and Nyquist needs pixels ≤ 0.20 µm; 40× with 6.5 µm pixels gives 0.1625 µm, which passes. The detection axial FWHM ≈ 2nλ/NA² = 2×1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 2.16 µm and the sheet FWHM is 2.35 µm; multiplying two Gaussians adds 1/FWHM², so the effective axial FWHM = 1/√(1/2.16² + 1/2.35²) ≈ 1.59 µm, smaller than either alone. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以凝膠中的 100 nm 螢光珠取 3D 影像，擬合橫向與軸向 FWHM，扣除珠徑後與模型比較（橫向預期約 0.41 µm）；以已知節距的網格校正放大率與像素尺寸；把光片移離焦平面量軸向 PSF 隨偏移的變化，分離偵測與照明各自的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image 100 nm beads in gel in 3D, fit lateral and axial FWHM and compare with the model after accounting for bead size (about 0.41 µm expected laterally); calibrate magnification and pixel size against a grid of known pitch; step the sheet away from the focal plane and measure how the axial PSF changes to separate detection and illumination contributions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以凝膠中的 100 nm 螢光珠取 3D 影像，擬合橫向與軸向 FWHM，扣除珠徑後與模型比較（橫向預期約 0.41 µm）；以已知節距的網格校正放大率與像素尺寸；把光片移離焦平面量軸向 PSF 隨偏移的變化，分離偵測與照明各自的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image 100 nm beads in gel in 3D, fit lateral and axial FWHM and compare with the model after accounting for bead size (about 0.41 µm expected laterally); calibrate magnification and pixel size against a grid of known pitch; step the sheet away from the focal plane and measure how the axial PSF changes to separate detection and illumination contributions. steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instruction: 為了加快速度把相機像素合併 2×2，樣品端像素變成 0.325 µm，超過 0.20 µm 的奈奎斯特限制，細胞膜與細絲出現鋸齒與混疊；研究者量到的絲狀結構寬度系統性偏寬，卻以為是生物變異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 光片與焦平面的對位校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Aligning the sheet to the focal plane: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光片傾角與焦平面共面」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光片必須與偵測物鏡的焦平面完全共面：光片中心偏離焦平面會讓訊號下降、背景上升；光片相對焦平面有傾角時，視野一側在焦內、另一側在焦外。校正通常用螢光珠或均勻螢光樣品，依序調整光片高度（照明側振鏡偏移）、傾角（與物鏡後焦面共軛的振鏡或鏡座）與光束腰位置（照明物鏡或電調透鏡），每一項都以影像銳利度或珠的軸向 PSF 為指標。雙側照明時兩片光必須分別對位，並確認兩者在中央重合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光片傾角與焦平面共面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The sheet must be exactly coplanar with the detection focal plane: a sheet centre offset from focus lowers signal and raises background, and a sheet tilted relative to focus leaves one side of the field sharp and the other blurred. Calibration usually uses beads or a uniform fluorescent sample, adjusting in turn sheet height (an illumination galvo offset), tilt (a galvo or mount conjugate to the objective back focal plane) and waist position (the illumination objective or tunable lens), each judged by image sharpness or bead axial PSF. With dual-sided illumination both sheets are aligned separately and confirmed to coincide at the centre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偵測景深 nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm，容許偏離 ±0.54 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detection depth of field nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm allows an offset of ±0.54 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片在組裝時對準一次，之後就不必再校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 光片與焦平面的對位校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aligning the sheet to the focal plane: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光片傾角與焦平面共面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偵測景深 nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm，容許偏離 ±0.54 µm。在 333 µm 視野的半寬 166 µm 上，傾角須小於 0.54/166 ≈ 3.2 mrad（0.19°）。照明物鏡焦距 20 mm、振鏡與後焦面共軛（放大率 1）時光片位移 = f·θ，0.54 µm 只對應 27 µrad 的振鏡角度，振鏡解析度與溫度漂移都必須低於這個等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detection depth of field nλ/NA² = 1.33×0.52/0.64 ≈ 1.08 µm allows an offset of ±0.54 µm. Over the 166 µm half-width of a 333 µm field the tilt must be below 0.54/166 ≈ 3.2 mrad (0.19°). With a 20 mm illumination-objective focal length and a galvo conjugate to the back focal plane at unit magnification, sheet displacement = f·θ, so 0.54 µm corresponds to only 27 µrad of galvo angle, and galvo resolution and thermal drift must both stay below that level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在螢光珠凝膠上以振鏡偏移掃描光片位置，記錄視野左、中、右三區的平均珠亮度，三條曲線峰值位置之差即反映傾角，修正後應小於 0.3 µm；開機後 1 小時內每 10 分鐘重複一次，記錄振鏡與機構的熱漂移曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a bead gel scan the sheet position with the galvo offset and record mean bead brightness in the left, centre and right of the field; the spread of the three curve peaks reveals the tilt and should be below 0.3 µm after correction; repeat every 10 minutes during the first hour after start-up to log galvo and mechanical thermal drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 光片與焦平面的對位校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aligning the sheet to the focal plane: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光片傾角與焦平面共面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在螢光珠凝膠上以振鏡偏移掃描光片位置，記錄視野左、中、右三區的平均珠亮度，三條曲線峰值位置之差即反映傾角，修正後應小於 0.3 µm；開機後 1 小時內每 10 分鐘重複一次，記錄振鏡與機構的熱漂移曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On a bead gel scan the sheet position with the galvo offset and record mean bead brightness in the left, centre and right of the field; the spread of the three curve peaks reveals the tilt and should be below 0.3 µm after correction; repeat every 10 minutes during the first hour after start-up to log galvo and mechanical thermal drift. steps.observation: 注意干擾：樣品槽換新後窗片厚度不同，照明光進入介質時的折射使光片高度偏移 3 µm，所有影像都偏暗偏糊；操作者以提高雷射功率補償，漂白因此加速，而真正需要的只是重新對位。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A new sample chamber has a different window thickness, refraction where the illumination enters the medium shifts the sheet height by 3 µm and every image is dim and soft; the operator compensates with more laser power, accelerating bleaching, when all that was needed was realignment.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在螢光珠凝膠上以振鏡偏移掃描光片位置，記錄視野左、中、右三區的平均珠亮度，三條曲線峰值位置之差即反映傾角，修正後應小於 0.3 µm；開機後 1 小時內每 10 分鐘重複一次，記錄振鏡與機構的熱漂移曲線。
knowledge.textEn: On a bead gel scan the sheet position with the galvo offset and record mean bead brightness in the left, centre and right of the field; the spread of the three curve peaks reveals the tilt and should be below 0.3 µm after correction; repeat every 10 minutes during the first hour after start-up to log galvo and mechanical thermal drift.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.titleEn: Aligning the sheet to the focal plane: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 樣品槽換新後窗片厚度不同，照明光進入介質時的折射使光片高度偏移 3 µm，所有影像都偏暗偏糊；操作者以提高雷射功率補償，漂白因此加速，而真正需要的只是重新對位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A new sample chamber has a different window thickness, refraction where the illumination enters the medium shifts the sheet height by 3 µm and every image is dim and soft; the operator compensates with more laser power, accelerating bleaching, when all that was needed was realignment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雙側照明時兩片光必須分別對位，並確認兩者在中央重合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With dual-sided illumination both sheets are aligned separately and confirmed to coincide at the centre.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光片在組裝時對準一次，之後就不必再校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sheet aligned once at assembly never needs recalibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 散射、吸收與折射率失配的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error budget for scattering, absorption and index mismatch: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「散射、陰影與折射率失配」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光片從側面穿過樣品，深處的光要先經過前方組織：散射把彈道光子轉成背景並讓光片變厚，吸收物（色素、卵黃）在其後方投下條紋陰影。樣品折射率與浸潤介質不同時，偵測物鏡看到的焦平面隨深度漂移，光片與焦平面逐漸分離。對策包括雙側照明（每側只負責一半寬度）、擺動掃描、多角度取像，以及組織透明化搭配折射率相符的介質；活體大樣品則需要隨深度動態補償焦距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The sheet crosses the sample from the side, so light reaching deep regions must first pass through the tissue in front: scattering converts ballistic photons into background and thickens the sheet, and absorbers such as pigment or yolk cast stripe shadows behind them. When sample and immersion medium differ in refractive index, the focal plane seen by the detection objective drifts with depth and the sheet and focal plane separate. Remedies include dual-sided illumination with each side covering half the width, pivot scanning, multi-angle acquisition and tissue clearing with index-matched media, while large live samples need depth-dependent focus compensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：散射長度 ls = 100 µm（教學假設）、樣品寬 600 µm：單側照明到對側路徑 600 µm，彈道比例 e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%；雙側照明最遠 300 µm，e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，提高 20 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a scattering length ls = 100 µm (teaching assumption) and a 600 µm wide sample, single-sided illumination travels 600 µm to the far side for a ballistic fraction of e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%; dual-sided illumination travels at most 300 µm for e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, twenty times more.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樣品透明之後，深處影像就和表面一樣清楚。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a sample is cleared, deep images are as sharp as the surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 散射、吸收與折射率失配的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error budget for scattering, absorption and index mismatch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：散射長度 ls = 100 µm（教學假設）、樣品寬 600 µm：單側照明到對側路徑 600 µm，彈道比例 e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%；雙側照明最遠 300 µm，e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，提高 20 倍。折射率失配：樣品 n = 1.45 置於水 n = 1.33，焦平面漂移率 1.45/1.33 − 1 ≈ 0.090，深入 50 µm 就偏 4.5 µm，是 1.08 µm 景深的 4 倍，2 mm 深時達 180 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a scattering length ls = 100 µm (teaching assumption) and a 600 µm wide sample, single-sided illumination travels 600 µm to the far side for a ballistic fraction of e⁻⁶ ≈ 0.25%; dual-sided illumination travels at most 300 µm for e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, twenty times more. For index mismatch, a sample of n = 1.45 in water at n = 1.33 drifts the focal plane at 1.45/1.33 − 1 ≈ 0.090, so 50 µm deep it is off by 4.5 µm, four times the 1.08 µm depth of field, and 2 mm deep by 180 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在加入散射微球的凝膠仿體中量光片厚度與訊號隨深度的衰減並擬合 ls；以分布在不同深度的螢光珠量最佳焦距對深度的曲線，斜率應接近 n_s/n_m − 1，據此建立動態補償表；比較單側、雙側與擺動掃描下影像條紋的對比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a gel phantom loaded with scattering microspheres measure sheet thickness and signal decay with depth and fit ls; with beads at several depths measure best focus versus depth, whose slope should approach n_s/n_m − 1, and build the dynamic compensation table from it; compare stripe contrast in single-sided, dual-sided and pivot-scanned images.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For index mismatch, a sample of n = 1.45 in water at n = 1.33 drifts the focal plane at 1.45/1.33 − 1 ≈ 0.090, so 50 µm deep it is off by 4.5 µm, four times the 1.08 µm depth of field, and 2 mm deep by 180 µm.

steps.title: 散射、吸收與折射率失配的誤差預算：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「散射、陰影與折射率失配」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在加入散射微球的凝膠仿體中量光片厚度與訊號隨深度的衰減並擬合 ls；以分布在不同深度的螢光珠量最佳焦距對深度的曲線，斜率應接近 n_s/n_m − 1，據此建立動態補償表；比較單側、雙側與擺動掃描下影像條紋的對比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 注意干擾：改用折射率 1.52 的新清除液，樣品槽卻仍裝 1.45 的浸潤介質並沿用舊補償表，失配率 0.048 使 2 mm 深處焦平面偏約 97 µm，影像越深越糊；深層細胞計數系統性偏低，被誤報為腦區之間的生物差異。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A new clearing agent at n = 1.52 is adopted while the chamber still holds 1.45 immersion medium with the old compensation table, so a 0.048 mismatch shifts focus by about 97 µm at 2 mm depth and images blur with depth; deep cell counts come out systematically low and are reported as biological differences between brain regions.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 散射、吸收與折射率失配的誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Error budget for scattering, absorption and index mismatch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 改用折射率 1.52 的新清除液，樣品槽卻仍裝 1.45 的浸潤介質並沿用舊補償表，失配率 0.048 使 2 mm 深處焦平面偏約 97 µm，影像越深越糊；深層細胞計數系統性偏低，被誤報為腦區之間的生物差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A new clearing agent at n = 1.52 is adopted while the chamber still holds 1.45 immersion medium with the old compensation table, so a 0.048 mismatch shifts focus by about 97 µm at 2 mm depth and images blur with depth; deep cell counts come out systematically low and are reported as biological differences between brain regions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對策包括雙側照明（每側只負責一半寬度）、擺動掃描、多角度取像，以及組織透明化搭配折射率相符的介質；活體大樣品則需要隨深度動態補償焦距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remedies include dual-sided illumination with each side covering half the width, pivot scanning, multi-angle acquisition and tissue clearing with index-matched media, while large live samples need depth-dependent focus compensation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樣品透明之後，深處影像就和表面一樣清楚。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a sample is cleared, deep images are as sharp as the surface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多視角融合與資料管線整合」與「系統驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration" and "System acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多視角融合與資料管線整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「多視角融合與資料管線」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiview fusion and data pipeline” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。多視角取像把樣品旋轉或用多支物鏡從不同方向拍同一體積，以嵌入的螢光珠或影像特徵配準，再以加權平均或多視角反摺積融合，得到接近等向的解析度與完整覆蓋。整合時資料量往往才是真正的瓶頸：sCMOS 相機持續以數百 MB/s 輸出，需要串流寫入磁碟陣列、即時壓縮與自動化的配準融合流程，否則長時間縮時實驗無法收尾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多視角融合與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. Multiview acquisition rotates the sample or uses several objectives to record the same volume from different directions, registers the views with embedded beads or image features, then fuses them by weighted averaging or multiview deconvolution for near-isotropic resolution and complete coverage. In integration the data volume is often the real bottleneck: sCMOS cameras stream hundreds of MB/s continuously, demanding streaming to disk arrays, on-the-fly compression and automated registration and fusion, without which long time-lapse experiments cannot be completed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multiview fusion and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：2048×2048、16 bit、100 fps 相機輸出 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s，雙相機約 1.68 GB/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光片實驗的限制主要在光學，資料處理只是後續小事。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Optics is the main limit; data handling is a minor afterthought." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「多視角融合與資料管線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Multiview fusion and data pipeline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. Multiview acquisition rotates the sample or uses several objectives to record the same volume from different directions, registers the views with embedded beads or image features, then fuses them by weighted averaging or multiview deconvolution for near-isotropic resolution and complete coverage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光片實驗的限制主要在光學，資料處理只是後續小事。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Optics is the main limit; data handling is a minor afterthought. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多視角融合與資料管線整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration" is correct?
options: 光片實驗的限制主要在光學，資料處理只是後續小事。
單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。
中央的螢光珠合格，就代表整個視野都合格。
optionsEn: Optics is the main limit; data handling is a minor afterthought.
A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows.
If beads at the centre pass, the whole field passes.
quiz.explanation: 單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多視角融合與資料管線整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多視角融合與資料管線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiview fusion and data pipeline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：2048×2048、16 bit、100 fps 相機輸出 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s，雙相機約 1.68 GB/s。每 30 秒取 400 層、連續 24 小時共 2880 個體積，單相機資料 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB。四視角融合後軸向解析度由約 1.6 µm 向橫向的 0.4 µm 靠近，但配準誤差須小於橫向解析度的一半，即約 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s. Taking 400 planes every 30 s for 24 hours gives 2880 volumes and 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB per camera. Four-view fusion moves axial resolution from about 1.6 µm toward the lateral 0.4 µm, but registration error must stay below half the lateral resolution, about 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm；比較單視角與融合後珠的 3D FWHM；長時間取像中監控寫入頻寬、緩衝區占用與掉幀數，確認儲存系統持續寫入速度至少是相機輸出的 1.5 倍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm; compare bead 3D FWHM in single views and the fusion; during long acquisitions monitor write bandwidth, buffer occupancy and dropped frames, confirming that sustained storage throughput is at least 1.5 times the camera output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 2048×2048、16 bit、100 fps 相機輸出 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s，雙相機約 1.68 GB/s。每 30 秒取 400 層、連續 24 小時共 2880 個體積，單相機資料 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB。四視角融合後軸向解析度由約 1.6 µm 向橫向的 0.4 µm 靠近，但配準誤差須小於橫向解析度的一半，即約 0.2 µm。
knowledge.textEn: A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s. Taking 400 planes every 30 s for 24 hours gives 2880 volumes and 2880×400×8.39 MB ≈ 9.7 TB per camera. Four-view fusion moves axial resolution from about 1.6 µm toward the lateral 0.4 µm, but registration error must stay below half the lateral resolution, about 0.2 µm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多視角融合與資料管線整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration", which statement holds?
options: 光片越薄越好，做薄不需要付出代價。
光片的厚度就是系統的軸向解析度。
optionsEn: A thinner sheet is always better and costs nothing.
The sheet thickness is the system's axial resolution.
A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s.
quiz.explanation: 2048×2048、16 bit、100 fps 相機輸出 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s，雙相機約 1.68 GB/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 2048×2048, 16-bit camera at 100 fps outputs 2048²×2 B×100 ≈ 839 MB/s, and two cameras about 1.68 GB/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多視角融合與資料管線整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「多視角融合與資料管線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Multiview fusion and data pipeline” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm；比較單視角與融合後珠的 3D FWHM；長時間取像中監控寫入頻寬、緩衝區占用與掉幀數，確認儲存系統持續寫入速度至少是相機輸出的 1.5 倍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm; compare bead 3D FWHM in single views and the fusion; during long acquisitions monitor write bandwidth, buffer occupancy and dropped frames, confirming that sustained storage throughput is at least 1.5 times the camera output. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：磁碟陣列持續寫入只有 700 MB/s，前幾分鐘靠記憶體緩衝看不出問題，數十分鐘後開始隨機掉幀，時間序列出現缺口，配準演算法把缺幀當成樣品突然移動，融合結果出現鬼影。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The disk array sustains only 700 MB/s; memory buffering hides it for the first few minutes, then frames drop at random after tens of minutes, the time series develops gaps, the registration algorithm reads missing frames as sudden sample motion and the fused result shows ghosts.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm；比較單視角與融合後珠的 3D FWHM；長時間取像中監控寫入頻寬、緩衝區占用與掉幀數，確認儲存系統持續寫入速度至少是相機輸出的 1.5 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm; compare bead 3D FWHM in single views and the fusion; during long acquisitions monitor write bandwidth, buffer occupancy and dropped frames, confirming that sustained storage throughput is at least 1.5 times the camera output.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多視角融合與資料管線整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration"?
options: 以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
光片在組裝時對準一次，之後就不必再校正。
optionsEn: Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sheet aligned once at assembly never needs recalibration.
quiz.explanation: 以嵌入次解析度螢光珠的樣品從四個角度取像，用珠位置配準並計算殘差均方根，應小於 0.2 µm；比較單視角與融合後珠的 3D FWHM；長時間取像中監控寫入頻寬、緩衝區占用與掉幀數，確認儲存系統持續寫入速度至少是相機輸出的 1.5 倍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image a sample with embedded sub-resolution beads from four angles, register on bead positions and compute the residual rms, which should be below 0.2 µm; compare bead 3D FWHM in single views and the fusion; during long acquisitions monitor write bandwidth, buffer occupancy and dropped frames, confirming that sustained storage throughput is at least 1.5 times the camera output. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 多視角融合與資料管線整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multiview fusion and data-pipeline integration: failure diagnosis

steps.objective: 說明「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」如何決定光片顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bead acceptance and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Light-sheet microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光片顯微鏡的驗收把前面每個模型變成量測：視野多處螢光珠的橫向與軸向 FWHM 驗證偵測解析度與光片均勻性；光片側影驗證 w0、z_R 與腰的位置；共面性掃描驗證傾角；觸發時序驗證同步；重複取像驗證漂白率與熱漂移；連續寫入測試驗證資料管線。交接紀錄必須包含每一組物鏡、介質與光片設定下的校正值，因為換介質、換樣品槽或換波長都會讓舊值失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Light-sheet acceptance turns each earlier model into a measurement: lateral and axial bead FWHM at many field positions verify detection resolution and sheet uniformity; the sheet profile verifies w0, z_R and waist position; a coplanarity scan verifies tilt; trigger timing verifies synchronization; repeated acquisition verifies bleach rate and thermal drift; a sustained write test verifies the data pipeline. The handoff record must hold calibration values for every combination of objective, medium and sheet setting, because a change of medium, chamber or wavelength invalidates the old values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead acceptance and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 nm 珠橫向 FWHM 預期 √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm，量得 0.42 µm；中心軸向預期 1.59 µm，量得 1.63 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Expected lateral FWHM for 100 nm beads is √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm, measured 0.42 µm; expected centre axial 1.59 µm, measured 1.63 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中央的螢光珠合格，就代表整個視野都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bead acceptance and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 nm 珠橫向 FWHM 預期 √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm，量得 0.42 µm；中心軸向預期 1.59 µm，量得 1.63 µm。靜態高斯光片在視野邊緣（z_R 處）光片 FWHM 變 3.33 µm，等效軸向 1.81 µm，邊緣／中心比 1.14；軸向掃描模式最大光片 FWHM 2.63 µm，比值應 ≤ 1.05。傾角 < 0.19°、觸發抖動 < 5 µs；24 小時 2880 疊後要保留一半訊號，每疊漂白須 ≤ 1 − 0.5^(1/2880) ≈ 0.024%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Expected lateral FWHM for 100 nm beads is √(0.397² + 0.1²) ≈ 0.41 µm, measured 0.42 µm; expected centre axial 1.59 µm, measured 1.63 µm. A static Gaussian sheet at the field edge (at z_R) widens to 3.33 µm FWHM for an effective axial 1.81 µm, an edge-to-centre ratio of 1.14; in axial-sweep mode the maximum sheet FWHM is 2.63 µm and the ratio should be ≤ 1.05. Tilt < 0.19°, trigger jitter < 5 µs; keeping half the signal after 2880 stacks in 24 hours needs bleaching per stack ≤ 1 − 0.5^(1/2880) ≈ 0.024%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依固定順序：熱平衡 1 小時；光片側影量 w0 與腰位置；螢光珠樣品在 3×3 個位置量 3D PSF；共面性掃描；示波器量觸發時序；同一樣品取 50 疊量漂白率；連續 1 小時全速寫入測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a fixed order: one hour of thermal settling; sheet profile for w0 and waist position; 3D PSFs of beads at 3×3 field positions; coplanarity scan; trigger timing on an oscilloscope; 50 stacks of one sample for bleach rate; a one-hour full-speed write test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 系統驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bead acceptance and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依固定順序：熱平衡 1 小時；光片側影量 w0 與腰位置；螢光珠樣品在 3×3 個位置量 3D PSF；共面性掃描；示波器量觸發時序；同一樣品取 50 疊量漂白率；連續 1 小時全速寫入測試。全部數值與模型並列填表，任何超出允收者記錄原因與重新校正的結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In a fixed order: one hour of thermal settling; sheet profile for w0 and waist position; 3D PSFs of beads at 3×3 field positions; coplanarity scan; trigger timing on an oscilloscope; 50 stacks of one sample for bleach rate; a one-hour full-speed write test. Tabulate every value beside its model, and record cause and recalibration result for anything outside the allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收只在視野中央量珠 PSF，邊緣因光束腰偏離中心 30 µm，軸向解析度差了 25%；使用者在邊緣量細胞體積系統性偏大，而交接紀錄沒有腰位置資料，無法追溯是哪次維修後發生的。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance measured bead PSFs only at the field centre, while a waist displaced 30 µm from centre leaves axial resolution 25% worse at the edge; users measuring cell volumes there get systematically large values, and with no waist position in the handoff record nobody can trace which service visit caused it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依固定順序：熱平衡 1 小時；光片側影量 w0 與腰位置；螢光珠樣品在 3×3 個位置量 3D PSF；共面性掃描；示波器量觸發時序；同一樣品取 50 疊量漂白率；連續 1 小時全速寫入測試。全部數值與模型並列填表，任何超出允收者記錄原因與重新校正的結果。
knowledge.textEn: In a fixed order: one hour of thermal settling; sheet profile for w0 and waist position; 3D PSFs of beads at 3×3 field positions; coplanarity scan; trigger timing on an oscilloscope; 50 stacks of one sample for bleach rate; a one-hour full-speed write test. Tabulate every value beside its model, and record cause and recalibration result for anything outside the allowance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

樣品透明之後，深處影像就和表面一樣清楚。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bead acceptance and handoff record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 驗收只在視野中央量珠 PSF，邊緣因光束腰偏離中心 30 µm，軸向解析度差了 25%；使用者在邊緣量細胞體積系統性偏大，而交接紀錄沒有腰位置資料，無法追溯是哪次維修後發生的。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance measured bead PSFs only at the field centre, while a waist displaced 30 µm from centre leaves axial resolution 25% worse at the edge; users measuring cell volumes there get systematically large values, and with no waist position in the handoff record nobody can trace which service visit caused it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄必須包含每一組物鏡、介質與光片設定下的校正值，因為換介質、換樣品槽或換波長都會讓舊值失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must hold calibration values for every combination of objective, medium and sheet setting, because a change of medium, chamber or wavelength invalidates the old values.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中央的螢光珠合格，就代表整個視野都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If beads at the centre pass, the whole field passes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
